name: smwgraphics-jumper-vt369-grassland
title: Jumper (VT369) - Grassland
description: The FG from Jumper, a bootleg reskin of Super Mario Bros. on the NES, made on the VT369. I had to compress the palettes into one, plus, I've added many tiles to make this tileset feel more "complete", basically turning this trash into something better, right?
